'''2004 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 19 June 2004 at Twin City Comics, 3954 Central Avenue NE, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, with [[Nick Kolnik]] as tournament director. It was the main event of a championship weekend that opened with a sealed deck tournament on Friday 18 June.<ref name="pcf-3386-47003">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47003#47003 2004 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021754/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47421%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, 3954 Central Avenue NE, Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" />
* '''Dates:''' 19 June 2004, 10:30 a.m.<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" /><ref name="pcf-3386-47421">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47421#47421 2004 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021754/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47421%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" />
* '''Structure:''' constructed, six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5.00<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" />

Trophies were to be awarded to the winner, runner-up, third and fourth place, and a junior champion trophy to the highest-placing participant aged 14 or younger. The winner received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship|World Championship at Gen Con]] and the opportunity to design a [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]] for a future expansion, and all participants were to receive prizes, including uncut sheets, tournament foils, oversized cards and booster packs.<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" /> When asked whether the championship started at 10:30 or noon, Kolnik confirmed 10:30.<ref name="pcf-3386-47421" />

== Side events ==

The [[Sealed Deck]] tournament on Friday 18 June at 6:00 p.m. ran four games, cost $5.00 and gave prizes to all; its participants received free entry to Saturday's championship.<ref name="pcf-3386-47003" />
